label: 2. Ugh, I don't wanna do my homework.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Ugh, I don't wanna do my homework.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Can you do it for me?
Do you have a lot of homework?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Oodles and boodles!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Way too much, if you ask me.
What have you been studying lately?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Nothing special, really.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Just ordinary coursework.
Actually, I've been meaning to ask you something.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: What is it?
What does the M.M.R. Vocational School do, exactly?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Well, in a nutshell,

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: it's...

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: meant to educate Nikkes.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: That sorta thing.
Then what's up with the name?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Beats me.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Maybe M.M.R. is one of the main donors of the school.
Shouldn't you know this kind of stuff by now?
Rei doesn't reply for a while.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: For most Nikkes, the limits of their performances are capped at the time of their production.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Others, however, are capable of improving these thresholds through further education.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: To learn more about this special subsect of Nikkes,

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: a special school was established.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: M.M.R is responsible for providing education and technical support to its students.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Therefore leading to its designation as a vocational school.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I've gotta ask Rei, why are you so curious about this all of a sudden?
... Did you just copy and paste messages Zwei sent you?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I didn't!
None of what you just said sounds like you at all.
There's something off about that last message you just sent.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I've already told you, I'm a third year student!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I can speak eloquently when I put my mind to it.
... If you say so.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I do say so.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Oh, that?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: That... must have been that darned autocorrect.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: It should say "Teacher",

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: not "Rei".
I'm not quite convinced you can blame autocorrect for that...

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I'm telling you, that's what happened!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Anyways, does that answer your question?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: If there's nothing else, I'd like to get started on my homework.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Oh, right.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I nearly forgot.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Do you want to do my homework for me?
No, I don't.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Fine...
